name: live-motion
description: A scripted live take with the fixtures' stand-in engine (ac_posefill::stand_in): it holds the start pose and moves the root by the velocity asked, 1/30 a frame, 30 frames a stretch with the transition on frame 19. The body starts at root z 0.9450101 with a key on frame 0. live.start names the shipped set's four targets. Five frames with the stick at rest: the first asks for a stretch (why start), the root stays, and the recording is the start pose and those 5 frames, 6. One frame with the stick at 1.3 m/s: moving from standing asks at once (why started) at 0.6 of the stick, 0.78 m/s along -Y, so the root moves 0.78 / 30 = 0.026 and y = -0.026. Nineteen more frames: stretch frames 2 to 19 play, y = -0.026 x 19 = -0.494, then frame 20 is past the transition and asks again (why transition) at the stick smoothed on from 0.78 over those 19 frames, 1.3 - 0.52 x 0.5^(19/18) = 1.04982 m/s, and that stretch's frame 1 moves it on by 1.04982 / 30 = 0.034994 to y = -0.528994; 26 frames, 3 calls. live.stop keeps the recording: nothing held or late, since a script waits for each stretch. live.clip of recorded frames 6 to 25 at frame 30 writes 20 frames, 30 to 49, its ends keys of yours and the 18 between AI keys tagged posefill; frame 30 is recorded frame 6, y = -0.026, and frame 49 recorded frame 25, y = -0.528994. One undo step takes it all away, leaving the key on frame 0, and redo brings it back. Refused, all leaving the animation as it was: a range of one frame, a range past the recording, a range landing on your key on 49 (at 40), more steering after the stop, and a start with a cap under 2 frames.

notes: made by the fixtures' stand-in, not the model
